IT Senior Platform Engineer position available in all states NSW, Qld, Vic, & WA

At NEPEAN™ we are proud to be Australia’s leading privately owned engineering, mining services and industrial manufacturing organisation. We have unique capabilities to deliver high value, innovative and sustainable solutions for the world’s leading mining, construction, and transport companies. Over the last 40 years, hard work, technical credibility, and a willingness to tackle very difficult projects have earned NEPEAN an enviable reputation. Today our organisation employs over 1400 people across six continents and distributes products to more than 65 countries.

We service our customers through multiple businesses in our portfolio: NEPEAN Building and Infrastructure (Galserv, Galintel, Weldlok), NEPEAN Engineering and Innovation, NEPEAN Power, Mining (NEPEAN Longwall), PROK, NEPEAN Conveyors, NEPEAN Transport, Gurtec, Roxon, and NEPEAN Belting Mackay.

We are currently offering a fantastic opportunity for IT Senior Platform Engineer – Microsoft Environment (Global Operations) based in our NSW Office.

THE ROLE

As an IT platform Engineer, you will provide Level 1 and Level 2 support in a Microsoft-centric enterprise environment while also supporting and maintaining the organisation’s Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) platform.

You will act as a key point of contact for end users, taking ownership of incidents and service requests from initial triage through to resolution. In addition to end-user support, you will play an active role in D365 administration, security configuration, user role management, and ongoing platform Maintenance.

Working within Freshservice (ITSM) and leveraging NinjaOne (RMM), you will support Windows endpoints, Microsoft 365 services, Active Directory/Entra ID, Microsoft Defender security tooling, and Dynamics 365 environments. You will contribute to continuous improvement, automation, and operational standardisation across our global IT and business systems landscape.

This role is ideal for a technically capable and customer-focused professional who enjoys solving problems, improving systems, and supporting business-critical platforms in a global support model.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Service Desk & End User Support
Provide remote support for users across Europe and the Americas.
Act as primary point of contact for incidents and service requests logged in Freshservice.
Deliver troubleshooting and resolution for:
Windows 10/11 environments
Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive)
Office applications and collaboration tools
VPN and basic network connectivity issues
Dynamics 365 user access and functional issues
Ensure tickets are categorised, prioritised, and resolved within agreed SLAs.

Dynamics 365 Administration & Platform Support
Administer and support Microsoft Dynamics 365 environments.
Manage D365 security roles, user access, and permission structures.
Configure and maintain:
Security roles and access profiles
Business units and role-based access controls
Environment-level security settings
Support user onboarding/offboarding within D365.
Troubleshoot D365 functional and access-related issues.
Assist with testing, validation, and deployment of D365 updates and changes.
Maintain environment health, performance monitoring, and basic configuration management.
Coordinate with application owners, vendors, and stakeholders for enhancements and issue resolution.
Ensure governance and compliance standards are maintained across D365 environments.

Identity & Access Management
Administer Active Directory and Entra ID (Azure AD).
Manage user lifecycle processes (onboarding, offboarding, access changes).
Configure and support:
Group memberships
Licensing
MFA and Conditional Access
Mailbox management
Align identity controls with D365 security and access models.

Endpoint & RMM Administration
Monitor and manage endpoints using NinjaOne RMM.
Perform patch management, remote remediation, and system monitoring.
Investigate recurring endpoint issues and implement long-term fixes.
Ensure endpoint compliance with security and configuration standards.

Security & Microsoft Defender
Monitor and respond to Microsoft Defender alerts (Endpoint and M365).
Support security best practices including device hardening and vulnerability remediation.
Escalate and coordinate response to suspected security incidents.
Support security posture across D365 through proper role design, least-privilege access, and periodic access reviews.

Problem Management & Continuous Improvement
Perform root cause analysis on recurring incidents (including D365-related issues).
Contribute to process improvement and service optimisation initiatives.
Develop and maintain knowledge base articles, SOPs, and technical documentation.
Identify opportunities for automation within NinjaOne, Microsoft tools, and D365 workflows.
Support governance and platform optimisation initiatives within the D365 ecosystem.

Collaboration & Global Support
Work closely with infrastructure, cybersecurity, application, and business systems teams.
Provide technical guidance to junior support staff when required.
Support change management, system updates, and release cycles (including D365 updates).
Participate in shift coverage aligned with Europe and Americas time zones.

ABOUT YOU

Experience
3–6+ years’ experience in IT Support / Service Desk / End User Computing roles.
Experience supporting a Microsoft-based enterprise environment.
Hands-on experience supporting or administering Microsoft Dynamics 365.
Exposure to global or multi-site support operations is desirable.
Experience with ITSM platforms (Freshservice preferred).
Experience with RMM tools (NinjaOne preferred).

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Strong working knowledge of:
Active Directory & Entra ID (Azure AD)
Microsoft 365 administration
Exchange Online
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
Windows OS administration
MFA and Conditional Access configuration
Dynamics 365 security roles and access management
Role-based access control (RBAC) principles
Basic networking concepts (DNS, DHCP, VPN)

Certifications (Desirable)
Microsoft certifications (MS-900, MD-102, AZ-900 or similar).
Dynamics 365 Fundamentals (MB-910 / MB-920 or similar).

Soft Skills
Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset.
Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal).
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a global support model.
Customer-first attitude with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
High level of accountability and ownership.

If you believe you the right skills, experience and passion for succeeding in this role, please submit your cover letter and resume for consideration.

NEPEAN believes in diversity and is committed to providing Equal Employment opportunities for all applicants. We welcome applicants from all walks of life which also included various socio-economic, cultural, LGBTIQ, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander backgrounds.

Salary: $100,000 per annum + Super

Summary

Our client JDE Homes is seeking to add a Construction Project Manager to its South Australian construction and development team. The company delivers fixed-price property construction, development and project management services across residential, civil, industrial and commercial projects. This role will support the planning, coordination and delivery of technically challenging building projects, while maintaining quality, budget, safety and completion requirements.

The typical job responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following:

- Plan, organise and manage construction projects from commencement through to practical completion.
- Coordinate project resources, including labour, subcontractors, materials, plant and equipment.
- Interpret architectural drawings, construction plans, engineering details and technical specifications.
- Monitor project budgets, timelines, quality standards, risks and contractual obligations.
- Liaise with architects, engineers, consultants, clients, subcontractors and relevant authorities.
- Manage procurement scheduling and ensure materials are available to meet construction milestones.
- Supervise site progress and ensure works align with approved plans and specifications.
- Coordinate inspections, approvals and documentation required by councils and regulatory bodies.
- Ensure adherence to workplace health, safety, building and performance standards.
- Negotiate with suppliers, subcontractors and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
- Prepare project reports, progress updates, cost reviews and construction documentation.
- Manage project variations, delays, defects and implementation of corrective actions.
- Lead subcontractors and site teams to achieve quality and programme outcomes.
- Support tender preparation, contract administration and construction methodology recommendations.
- Maintain professional communication with clients to support cost-effective project delivery.

Applicants must meet the following minimum requirements to be considered for the role:

- Minimum ten years of relevant experience in construction project management or building project delivery.
- Strong ability to manage residential, commercial, civil or industrial construction projects from start to finish.
- Demonstrated experience coordinating subcontractors, trades, consultants, suppliers, plant, equipment and site resources.
- Sound knowledge of construction drawings, specifications, building processes, safety obligations and quality standards.
- Proven ability to monitor project costs, budgets, schedules, risks, variations and completion deadlines.
- Strong communication skills for liaising with clients, architects, engineers, authorities and internal project teams.
- Practical experience resolving construction issues and recommending cost-effective building methods or project solutions.
- Ability to work without direct supervision while maintaining accurate project records and professional standards.

Please include Reference: J1697-Workforce in the Subject Line and email all applications and CV to apply@jobsource.net.au

Due to the volume of applicants, only those meeting the minimum standards will be considered and only successful applicants will be contacted.  Thank you for your interest in the role.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Job Description:

Build Australia's Next Generation Health Data Platform

Design the data that helps deliver better healthcare to millions of Australians.

Build technology that improves lives - Design and optimise enterprise-scale data platforms that directly support patient care, operational performance and nationally significant digital health initiatives.

Work at the forefront of AI and modern data engineering - Build cloud-native data pipelines powering advanced analytics, Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions using Azure, Microsoft Fabric and Databricks.

Shape the future of healthcare data - Influence enterprise architecture, governance and engineering standards across one of Australia's largest not-for-profit health systems.

What if your next engineering challenge could genuinely improve healthcare? 

Most Data Engineering roles focus on moving data from A to B.

This one helps transform how healthcare is delivered across Australia.

At St Vincent's Health Australia, we're building intelligent, secure and scalable data platforms that empower clinicians, operational leaders and researchers to make better decisions, faster. Every pipeline you build, every platform you optimise and every improvement you deliver contributes to better patient care and a stronger health system.

You'll join a collaborative Digital & Technology team driving enterprise-wide data capability across one of Australia's largest healthcare organisations. Working with Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks and modern engineering practices, you'll help build scalable platforms that support advanced analytics, AI, automation and the next generation of digital healthcare.

If you're looking for a role where technical excellence meets meaningful purpose, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Program - Medicare Mental Health Check-In

This role supports one of Australia's most innovative digital health initiatives.

The Medicare Mental Health Check-In is a national virtual mental health service delivered in partnership with the Australian Government, providing accessible, evidence-based mental healthcare to people across Australia.

Data is fundamental to the success of this service.

As our Data Engineer, you'll help design and build the secure, scalable data platforms that enable real-time reporting, operational insights, advanced analytics and future AI capabilities that support clinicians and improve patient outcomes.

About St Vincent's Health Australia

For more than 165 years, St Vincent's Health Australia has been providing compassionate care to Australians.

Founded by the Sisters of Charity in 1857, we have grown into one of Australia's largest not-for-profit health and aged care providers.

Today, more than 30,000 employees deliver care across public hospitals, private hospitals, aged care, home care, virtual care, research and community services throughout New South Wales, Victoria and Queensland.

Our vision is simple but ambitious-to deliver excellent and compassionate care within a better and fairer health and aged care system.

Digital transformation is central to achieving that vision, and data is at the heart of everything we do.

The Opportunity 

This is far more than a traditional Data Engineering role.

You'll become a key contributor to the design, development and evolution of our enterprise data platform, enabling trusted data across operational reporting, predictive analytics, AI and enterprise decision-making.

Working closely with architects, analysts, clinicians, product teams and business stakeholders, you'll engineer modern cloud-based data solutions that are scalable, secure and built for the future.

You'll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards, contribute to enterprise architecture decisions and help shape the future of data across St Vincent's Health Australia.

This is a 12-month full-time fixed-term opportunity, based in our Melbourne Group Office with hybrid working arrangements.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll have the opportunity to:

Design, build and optimise enterprise-scale ETL and ELT pipelines

Develop modern cloud-native data solutions using Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric and Databricks

Design and maintain scalable data warehouse and lakehouse environments

Apply software engineering best practices including CI-CD, automated testing, version control and Infrastructure as Code

Develop high-performing data models that support enterprise analytics and reporting

Build trusted data foundations that enable Machine Learning, advanced analytics and Generative AI initiatives

Develop vector database pipelines supporting Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions

Ensure data governance, security, quality and compliance within a healthcare environment

Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, architects and business stakeholders to deliver high-value solutions

Monitor, troubleshoot and continuously improve platform reliability, scalability and performance

Contribute to documentation, engineering standards and the ongoing uplift of enterprise data capability

About You

You're an experienced Data Engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges while delivering meaningful business outcomes.

You combine strong engineering capability with curiosity, collaboration and a passion for continuous improvement.

You're comfortable working across both technical and non-technical teams and enjoy building elegant, scalable solutions that make a real difference.

# Motor Mechanic

## About Gold Coast Car Electrics & Mechanical

Gold Coast Car Electrics & Mechanical is a trusted independent automotive workshop committed to delivering high-quality mechanical repairs, servicing and diagnostic solutions. We service a wide range of petrol, diesel and hybrid vehicles, combining advanced diagnostic technology with skilled workmanship to ensure our customers' vehicles remain safe, reliable and performing at their best.

We are seeking a qualified and motivated **Motor Mechanic** to join our growing team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who takes pride in their workmanship, enjoys solving technical problems and values delivering outstanding customer service.

## Key Responsibilities

As a Motor Mechanic, you will be responsible for:

* Diagnosing mechanical faults using diagnostic equipment and technical expertise.
* Performing servicing, maintenance and repairs on petrol, diesel and hybrid vehicles in accordance with manufacturer specifications.
* Inspecting engines, transmissions, suspension, steering, braking and cooling systems to identify faults and determine repair requirements.
* Removing, dismantling, repairing and replacing worn or defective mechanical components.
* Carrying out engine tuning, timing adjustments and performance-related repairs to ensure optimum vehicle operation.
* Inspecting and repairing driveline components, clutches, gearboxes, differentials and exhaust systems.
* Completing scheduled logbook servicing, preventative maintenance and vehicle safety inspections.
* Testing vehicles before and after repairs to verify that faults have been rectified and the vehicle is safe and roadworthy.
* Maintaining accurate service records and clearly communicating repair recommendations to customers and the service team.
* Ensuring all work is completed efficiently while complying with workplace health and safety requirements and industry standards.
* Maintaining a clean, organised and safe workshop environment, including the proper care of tools and equipment.

## Essential Qualifications and Experience

* AQF Certificate III in Light Vehicle Mechanical Technology (or equivalent) with at least two years of on-the-job training, or AQF Certificate IV. Alternatively, a minimum of three years of relevant industry experience.
* At least two years' experience as a qualified Motor Mechanic is preferred.
* Current Australian driver's licence (preferred).

## Skills and Attributes

The successful applicant will demonstrate:

* Strong diagnostic and fault-finding skills across a wide range of vehicle makes and models.
* Sound knowledge of automotive mechanical systems and manufacturer repair procedures.
* Experience using modern diagnostic scan tools and workshop equipment.
* Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
* Strong customer service and communication skills.
* Good organisational and time-management skills with the ability to prioritise workloads.
* The ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team.
* A strong commitment to quality workmanship, workplace safety and customer satisfaction.

## Employment Details

* **Position:** Permanent Full-Time
* **Salary:** AU$80,000 per annum plus employer superannuation contributions at the statutory rate.
* **Location:** Ashmore, Gold Coast, Queensland
* **Job Type:** Full-time

Job description
Position Summary
The Graphic Pre-press is responsible for preparing, processing and converting customer artwork, images, text and design files into print-ready formats for commercial printing, packaging, labels and other visual media applications. The role ensures all pre-press activities meet customer specifications, production requirements and quality standards before printing commences. 
Main Duties and Responsibilities
Artwork and File Preparation
•	Review customer artwork and design files for printability and technical compliance.
•	Prepare, manipulate and format text, graphics and images for printing and digital output.
•	Generate layouts, page impositions and print-ready files using specialised pre-press software.
•	Perform pre-flight checks to identify and correct file errors before production.
•	Ensure artwork complies with customer specifications, dimensions and production requirements. 
Image Processing and Colour Management
•	Scan, edit, retouch and optimise digital images.
•	Perform colour correction, colour separation and colour matching processes.
•	Apply colour management systems and profiles to achieve accurate print reproduction.
•	Evaluate colour consistency and quality throughout the pre-press process. 
Proofing and Quality Control
•	Produce digital and hard-copy proofs for customer approval.
•	Review proofs against artwork specifications and printing requirements.
•	Identify and rectify errors relating to colour, positioning, text, image quality and layout.
•	Maintain quality assurance standards and compliance with company procedures. 
Plate and Output Preparation
•	Operate computer-to-plate (CTP) and other plate-making systems.
•	Prepare printing plates, films and digital output devices for production.
•	Ensure output files are compatible with printing equipment and workflows.
•	Monitor and maintain pre-press production systems and equipment. 
Production Support
•	Liaise with customers, designers, printers and production staff regarding artwork requirements.
•	Provide technical advice on print limitations, artwork preparation and production specifications.
•	Assist in troubleshooting pre-press and printing issues.
•	Support continuous improvement initiatives within the printing production workflow. 
________________________________________
Key Accountabilities
•	Accurate preparation of artwork and print-ready files.
•	Compliance with production schedules and customer deadlines.
•	Maintenance of colour accuracy and print quality standards.
•	Reduction of printing errors and production waste.
•	Efficient operation of pre-press systems and software.
•	Compliance with workplace health and safety requirements.
•	Effective communication with customers and internal stakeholders.
________________________________________
Typical Skills and Knowledge
•	Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign).
•	PDF workflow management.
•	Pre-flight and imposition software.
•	Colour management systems and ICC profiles.
•	Computer-to-Plate (CTP) technology.
•	Print production processes including offset, flexographic and digital printing.
•	Quality assurance and proofing procedures. ________________________________________
Qualification Level
ANZSCO Skill Level 3
•	Typically requires:
•	AQF Certificate III in Printing and Graphic Arts (Pre-press) with relevant on-the-job training; or
•	AQF Certificate IV qualification; or
•	At least three years of relevant industry experience may substitute for formal qualifications in some circumstances.
Salary & Career Outlook
• Salary: Range from $75,000 to $85,000 per year, depending on the specific industry and experience level.
